description: A code customers enter when booking: a percentage or an amount off the price before tax (nights, hours, days, seats and add-ons; never fees). Optional limits: usable dates, stay dates, minimum spend or nights, total uses, once per customer, specific listings. Set active: false (with codeId) to switch one off; bookings that used it keep their discount.

code.description: Letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores, e.g. WELCOME10

codeId.description: To switch an existing code on or off (from list_discount_codes); then only active is used

listingIds.description: Only these listings; otherwise every listing and course

minSpend.description: Price before the discount, normal currency units

staysUntil.description: The whole stay must be inside these dates

usableUntil.description: Last day it can be entered (inclusive)

name: create_discount_code
title: Create a discount code
